title: gait-reliability-head: code, weights and results for "Know Which Body Part to Trust: A Plug-in Per-Part Reliability Head for Robust Few-Shot Gait Enrollment and Rejection"
description: Code, trained weights and per-run result files for a plug-in per-part reliability head for frozen part-based gait recognition models. For every body part of every sample, the head predicts a variance; a single Gaussian likelihood then provides reliability-aware matching, precision-weighted enrollment, rejection of unknown walkers and an exact per-part decomposition of every decision. The archive includes the evaluation scripts for CASIA-B, CASIA-E and OU-MVLP and for four frozen OpenGait checkpoints (GaitSet, GaitPart, GaitGL, GaitBase), and the generators of every table and figure of the paper. The datasets and OpenGait checkpoints are not redistributed.
